newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Huangshan Tourism to issue 50 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: China's Huangshan Tourism to issue 50 mln A shares.

text.p: Huangshan Tourism on Tuesday announced plans to issue 50 million A shares, and trading in its B shares on the Shanghai stock exchange was suspended until Wednesday, a company official said.
The official said the timing and price of the offer will be decided by a meeting of the company's shareholders to be held on Tuesday.
The company currently has a total of 193 million oustanding shares, including 113 million state shares and 80 million B shares listed in November 1996.
